subject: How do I order stacked bar charts?

messages.author: 33730d0de61ed699
messages.subject: How do I order stacked bar charts?
parts:
Hi,

how do I change the order of stacked bar charts? 
The answer should be: "Change the factor levels" but that doesn't work:


A<-structure(
  list(
    Sektor = c("G", "H", "K", 
                             "I", "R", 
                             "S", "V", "O", 
                             "G", "H", "K", "I", "R", 
                             "S", "V", "O"
    ), 
    variable = structure(
      c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L), .Label = c("Z", "A"), class = c("ordered", "factor")), 
    value = c(7L, 22L, 63L, 116L, 6L, 91L, 5L, 13L, 3L, 10L, 33L, 73L, 0L, 47L, 4L, 5L)), .Names = c("Sektor", "variable", "value"), 
  row.names = c(NA, -16L), class = "data.frame")

A$variable<-factor(A$variable,levels=c("A","Z"))

ggplot(A,aes(x=Sektor,
             y=value,
             fill=variable
)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",stat="identity")

A$variable<-factor(A$variable,levels=c("Z","A"))

ggplot(A,aes(x=Sektor,
             y=value,
             fill=variable
)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",stat="identity")

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: How do I order stacked bar charts?
parts:
Hi,

This is a known bug, see https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/721.
For now you can work around by explicitly setting the order, e.g.,

ggplot(A,aes(x=Sektor,
y=value,
fill=variable,
order=variable
)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity")

Best,
Ista
